sourceText.he: אֲפִילּוּ נָחָשׁ כָּרוּךְ עַל עֲקֵבוֹ, לֹא יַפְסִיק. אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא נָחָשׁ. אֲבָל עַקְרָב — פּוֹסֵק.

positions.claim: one does not interrupt prayer even for a snake wrapped around his heel
only for a snake, which does not bite unprovoked; for a scorpion one interrupts
positions.basis: a scorpion stings even when not disturbed
